relevance.rationale: FILENAME/CONTENT MISMATCH -- the highest-value finding on this file. The filename names a braid-groups-and-Hodge-theory paper; the document's own front matter is a much older complex-dynamics paper, on the braiding of attractors and the consequent failure of iterative algorithms. It has no text layer (extraction returns 14 characters) and was read by rendering pages, so a filename-driven pipeline would never have caught the mismatch. Its actual content is complex dynamics: the braid traced by attractors in a stable family of rational maps has mapping class either reducible, finite, or fixing an attractor; consequently purely iterative root-finding algorithms built from rational maps must fail near degree-d power maps for d at least 4, and no continuous assignment of such a map exists. The corpus's braid usage is Hecke- and knot-theoretic and its Newton usage is numerical root-location on a discriminant grid and Thurston gluing-equation solving; neither is the space of iterative root-finding algorithms this paper constrains. Judged on the document actually present: tangential. Any prior seeding or expectation keyed to the filename should be treated as unverified.
